reviewer_note: Premise check first: the Dispatch job form (Views/DispatchView.axaml) has NO driver field at all - fields are Title, Customer, Priority, Pickup, Drop-off, Assigned vehicle, Notes. Driver lives only on Models/Vehicle.cs and is shown only on the Vehicles screen. So nothing is literally asked twice; the real defect is that driver identity is implied by an opaque vehicle-id combo ('V-102'), forcing dispatchers to cross-reference the Vehicles grid and re-type the driver name into Notes. Correct fix: surface the driver as a DERIVED, read-only value next to Assigned vehicle (single source of truth on Vehicle), do NOT add an editable Driver field, and do not break the existing dirty/unsaved-changes guard or the ComboBox binding.
